headline: Standing Deputy Prime Minister: Housing development must meet demand, avoid speculation and waste
summary: Standing Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc said housing development must be based on actual needs, residents' ability to pay and local conditions. He also warned against speculation and waste.
why: Vietnamese government housing policy shapes the country's real estate developers and the wider property market, which is a large part of its economy.
